Focus $BE via $BEX 2x Long (higher low)

Another tightened higher low print. Looking at 20% RVOL in opening 30mins at ORH <70% for entry.

Stalk $MARA (Mini Bull Flag)

The most optimal entry in the recent period for $MARA would have been Sept 18th, the flag pole formation of current bullish flag setup but that execution is not viable as the prior day action has already loosen up. If strength could persist in this back to YTD high, RVOL will surface again, similar to August 20th, September 3rd and September 18th first big move out of downtrend line resistance.

Educational Thread - When Do I Remove A Stalk/Focus from my watchlist

Using $BE current gap down as an example: when the structure breaks down like this, it invalidates the initial hypothesis of tightening higher low prints for an potential breakout entry. A gap down of this magnitude negates the entire trading thesis, making it an immediate removal from the Stalk/Focus list.

Just to add, if this gap remains unfilled over the next few sessions, it will become a gap-down resistance zone. I would not anticipate any potential trading setup that develops directly into this gap zone. This is hard rule #8.

Stalk $RDW (PEG Delayed Reaction)

PEG was August 6th on +87% EPS +90% Sales YoY and price has drifted back within that PEG print range with a 6 print sideway box sitting on a cluster of 10/20/50/200-MA. Today's move also re-captured 150-MA again after whipsawing daily on this MA for the last 6 session. A stock capable of momentum expansion to 10 x ATR% from 50-MA as last witnessed in late May. Range still loose but it's a RS name against $ITA group.
